description: Exact final-pass Toffoli reduction for reversible/quantum op streams: replace repeated unconditional Toffolis with a CX copy from a held wire (product holds), and clear-then-rebuild idle live wires whose value another live wire duplicates (dup loans, Clifford-only). Uses affine symbolic value tracking with a random 128-bit hash, a provable width cap, and fail-closed relocation. Use when a stream recomputes products or carries duplicated live values over idle intervals.
